description: Iovurara wears an opaque burgundy-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, naturally fitted bodice and elbow-length outer sleeves. Gold floral and geometric woven borders run around the neckline, straps, waist, sleeves and skirt hem. Small round bronze shoulder brooches and earrings provide restrained jewelry. Ivory linen underlayers show at the forearms and skirt opening. A broad cream shawl with burgundy and gold borders rests along her arms. A narrow decorated belt has a central round clasp. Brown embroidered leather shoes appear beneath the skirt. No headgear or weapon appears.
